items.title: Biwin M560 2TB SSD Review: The DRAM-less drive to beat
items.description: The Biwin M560 brings SMI’s SM2504XT to retail with top-tier responsiveness and excellent efficiency, though not the fastest post-cache writes.
items.content: We’re back with another drive from Biwin, which has been putting out some good SSDs with minor exceptions. This one uses hardware we’ve wanted to test in retail for quite some time: the SMI SM2504XT SSD controller, which is hard to find. The PCIe 5.0 DRAM-less range is relatively popular because it offers the performance without the power and heat of higher-end options, at a lower price point. The tech’s newer than what PCIe 4.0 drives offer, so you get a better all-around experience if you’re willing to take the plunge. The M560 slots in here perfectly as a real alternative to all the drives in this class with Phison hardware.Biwin M560 Specifications Swipe to scroll horizontally Product 1TB 2TB Pricing $189.99 $364.99 Form Factor M.2 2280 (Single-sided) M.2 2280 (Single-sided) Interface / Protocol PCIe 5.0 x4 / NVMe 2.0 PCIe 5.0 x4 / NVMe 2.0 Controller SMI SM2504XT SMI SM2504XT DRAM DRAM-less / HMB DRAM-less / HMB Memory 218-layer BiCS8 TLC (Kioxia) 218-layer BiCS8 TLC (Kioxia) Sequential Read 11,000 MB/s 11,000 MB/s Sequential Write 9,700 MB/s 10,000 MB/s Random Read 1,400K 1,700K Random Write 1,600K 1,700K Security N/A N/A Endurance (TBW) 750TB 1,500TB Part Number BM560NN01TB-RGX BM560NN02TB-RGX Height 2.45 mm 2.45 mm Warranty 5-Year 5-Year Today's best Biwin M560 2TB SSD deals $364.99View No price informationCheck Best BuyWe check over 250 million products every day for the best pricesThe Biwin M560 is available only in 1TB and 2TB capacities. Is that a disappointment? It’s normal to expect at least 4TB SKUs these days, but 8TB is certainly a bridge too far for a four-channel controller. Yes, we have some 8TB DRAM-less drives floating around, but for the most part you can’t find those units. 4TB is more common and highly desired — this is what makes the Lexar NM790 so legendary — but it actually is a decent amount of flash for this type of controller. With the ideal amount of flash for this controller being four dies per channel, or 16 total, 2TB really is the sweet spot. So we’re fine with that for this drive, even if it is higher-end.Biwin M560 2TB SSD (2TB SSD) at Amazon for $364.99Right now the drive can be found for $189.99 and $364.99 for the two SKUs, which is not unreasonably priced for the hardware. At 2TB, it is right in line with the Crucial P510, for example. It’s also below the top drives with DRAM, like the Samsung 9100 Pro, by enough that it makes sense. You can get PCIe 5.0 DRAM SSDs at around this price or cheaper, but you’re giving up some things to do so, which we’ll get into later.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The drive is rated for up to 11,000 / 10,000 MB/s for sequential reads and writes and up to a whopping 1,700K / 1,700K random read and write IOPS. 1.7 million IOPS! That’s astounding, and even exceeds the 1.3+ million, on paper, from direct competitor Phison E31T-based drives, like the Corsair MP700 Elite. This thing is a beast for a DRAM-less drive.Biwin doesn’t skimp on the warranty, either. It’s the typical five-year affair for duration, but you’re covered for up to 750TB of writes for every TB of space. This is 25% more than is typical, if you care about that sort of thing. We consider it a bonus.Biwin M560 Software and AccessoriesHitting the download tab for the M560’s site shows three downloads available: the Biwin Data Recovery Tool for macOS, one for Windows, and Biwin Intelligence. The first two are pretty self-explanatory, but we will give kudos to Biwin for having the macOS option. For the last, it is the company’s SSD toolbox, which is an all-in-one software solution dashboard you can use to check your drive’s health, update firmware, and so forth. Biwin lists the supported functions on its page. The toolbox only supports Windows at this time.Biwin M560: A Closer Look Image 1 of 2 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Image 1 of 2 View Original Image 2 of 2 View Original The Biwin M560 is, as expected, a single-sided drive, which we prefer. Less that can go wrong, fits into more machines, and can be easier to cool. The top label is heat-spreading. The back label has drive information, including the 3.3 V / 2.0 A rating, which puts the drive power draw below about 7W. According to the S.M.A.R.T. report, the maximum power draw is 8W.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsThese numbers might be concerning, especially as good DRAM-less SSDs tend to be at around 6.5W or less. Well, as it turns out, the drive is much more comfortable at 4W, with a maximum significantly below 6.5W and an average of one-half that, as you can explore in more detail with our power testing. Even very efficient PCIe 5.0 drives tend to step up over the last generation, making heat something to watch in some cases. Not in this one — we think this will be great in laptops, and exceptionally cool in PCIe 4.0 ones. Image 1 of 3 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Image 1 of 3 View Original Image 2 of 3 View Original Image 3 of 3 View Original The components don’t even take up half of the PCB space! Impressive engineering, and the extra spacing between components can help spread heat. Here we have one controller, the SMI SM2504XT, which we previously covered in an ES preview, and two NAND flash packages. The controller performed exceptionally in our preview testing and is more than a match for the best controllers out there, whether Phison’s competing E31T or even many drives with DRAM such as those based on the E26. The flash, in this case, is Kioxia’s 218-layer BiCS8 TLC, which is also exceptional. This flash has excellent latency and is also power-efficient. This combination is a match made in heaven, and it’s a shame we don’t see the SM2504XT more often.MORE: Best SSDsMORE: Best External SSDsMORE: Best SSD for the Steam DeckBiwin M560 2TB SSD: Price Comparison $364.99View No price informationCheck Best BuyWe check over 250 million products every day for the best pricespowered by

items.titleZh: 佰维 M560 2TB SSD 评测：无DRAM缓存硬盘中的标杆
items.descriptionZh:
Biwin M560 是一款采用 PCIe 5.0 接口、无独立 DRAM 的高性能 SSD，提供 1TB 和 2TB 两种容量，定价分别为 189.99 美元和 364.99 美元。这款产品最受关注的地方，是搭载了零售市场较少见的慧荣 SM2504XT 主控，并搭配铠侠 218 层 BiCS8 TLC 闪存。当前 PCIe 5.0 DRAM-less SSD 之所以逐渐流行，是因为它们能在较低价格下提供接近高端产品的性能，同时避免高端 PCIe 5.0 盘常见的较高功耗和发热。M560 的定位正是这一类别中采用 Phison 硬件之外的一个有竞争力的替代选择。

从技术原理看，M560 采用 DRAM-less 设计，通过 HMB（Host Memory Buffer，主机内存缓冲）借用系统内存来维护映射表等数据，从而省去独立 DRAM 芯片，降低成本和功耗。它使用四通道的 SM2504XT 主控，文章指出这类控制器较理想的闪存配置是每通道 4 个 die、总共 16 个 die，因此 2TB 容量正好处在一个较优的甜点位置。虽然缺少 4TB 选项略显遗憾，但 8TB 对四通道控制器并不现实，2TB 在性能和容量之间较为均衡。闪存方面，铠侠 218 层 BiCS8 TLC 具备较好的延迟表现和能效，与 SM2504XT 组合后形成了非常出色的搭配。文章甚至认为，这套组合堪称“天作之合”，并遗憾 SM2504XT 在零售产品中不够常见。

性能参数方面，M560 标称顺序读取最高 11,000 MB/s；顺序写入 1TB 为 9,700 MB/s，2TB 为 10,000 MB/s。随机性能方面，1TB 为 1,400K 随机读取和 1,600K 随机写入 IOPS，2TB 则达到 1,700K / 1,700K IOPS。1.7M IOPS 对一款 DRAM-less 产品来说非常惊人，纸面上甚至超过直接竞争对手——采用 Phison E31T 的 Corsair MP700 Elite 等产品所标称的 130 万+ IOPS。文章认为，SM2504XT 的性能足以匹敌市面上最好的主控之一，不仅能对抗 Phison E31T，也能与不少带 DRAM 的方案，包括基于 E26 的 SSD 竞争。价格上，2TB 版与 Crucial P510 基本处于同一水平，同时明显低于 Samsung 9100 Pro 等带 DRAM 的旗舰产品；市场上虽然也能找到同价甚至更便宜的 PCIe 5.0 带 DRAM SSD，但通常会在某些方面有所妥协。

在设计与功耗方面，M560 采用单面 M.2 2280 形态，文章更偏好这种设计，因为它更少出错、兼容更多设备，也更容易散热。顶部标签具有导热/均热作用，背面标签标注了 3.3V / 2.0A 的供电规格，对应功耗低于约 7W；S.M.A.R.T. 报告显示最大功耗为 8W。不过实际测试中，该盘在 4W 左右更舒适，最大功耗显著低于 6.5W，平均功耗约为其一半。对于一款高性能 PCIe 5.0 SSD 来说，这样的能效表现相当突出，文章认为它非常适合笔记本电脑，在 PCIe 4.0 平台上也会非常凉爽。其 PCB 上元件占用不到一半空间，元件之间留有较大间距，有助于分散热量。保修方面，M560 提供 5 年质保，且每 TB 容量对应 750TBW 写入耐久度，比常见水平高约 25%。软件方面，Biwin 提供 macOS 和 Windows 版数据恢复工具，以及目前仅支持 Windows 的 Biwin Intelligence SSD 工具箱，可用于查看健康状态、更新固件等。

总体来看，Biwin M560 的意义在于把零售市场难得一见的 SM2504XT 主控与高能效的铠侠 BiCS8 TLC 闪存结合起来，在 DRAM-less PCIe 5.0 产品中实现了很强的顺序和随机性能，同时保持较低功耗和单面设计。它适合追求高性能但重视能效、发热和兼容性的用户，尤其是笔记本和 PCIe 4.0 平台用户；其容量选择集中在 1TB 和 2TB，也符合四通道控制器的合理区间。对于希望避开 Phison E31T 方案、寻找同级替代品的消费者来说，M560 提供了一个有吸引力的新选择。

items.title: Sam Altman meets with Samsung leadership to secure more RAM for data centers amid crushing shortages
items.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman met with around 50 Samsung executives in South Korea on October 31 to discuss AI's future, business opportunities and the technology's impact on corporate operations. The meeting comes as demand for memory chips grows alongside AI infrastructure spending, putting pressure on global DRAM supplies. Samsung and SK hynix together accounted for approximately 83% of global high-bandwidth memory revenue in the second quarter of 2026, highlighting South Korea's central role in supplying the hardware behind the AI expansion.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 4 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has met with about 50 senior Samsung executives in South Korea, as the company seeks to expand its Artificial Intelligence and memory capacity, Bloomberg reports. Altman’s visit to South Korea follows his recent comments about how the world's limited memory supply should be allocated. In an interview on the Chick Pink podcast this week, the OpenAI chief argued that DRAM sitting inside personal computers is often underused, describing it as “quite terrible”. He suggested that data centers could make more intensive use of memory by sharing computer resources across AI workloads. The argument has drawn widespread criticism given OpenAI’s own services like ChatGPT rely heavily on centralized computing infrastructure.The meeting, which took place at Samsung’s Resources Development Center in Yongin on Saturday, October 30, brought together chiefs from the company’s financial, electronics, and biotechnology businesses. Confirming the meeting, Samsung Korea said the discussion revolved around strengthening existing relationships between the two companies, particularly a letter of Intent signed in October 20225 to cooperate on global AI infrastructure, including supplying memory semiconductors for OpenAI’s Stargate project. “The Samsung executives and CEO Sam Altman discussed the direction of AI technology development and its potential applications, as well as new markets and business opportunities that will emerge from it,” Samsung stated.Samsung, however, emphasized more on AI transformation and future business opportunities, rather than announcing a new memory supply agreement. Reportedly, Altman also presented Samsung’s AI Center head with a Codex Micro Keyboard, a device designed for use with OpenAI’s coding agent. The latest meeting comes as demand from AI centers continues to soar, with AMD forecasting DRAM revenue will jump 177% in 2026 to about $416 billion. Trendforce also estimates DRAM supply will fall 1% to 2% short of demand this year, with the imbalance expected to worsen in 2027. New manufacturing capacity may take time to come, which means the shortage could persist into 2028, as per a recent warning by Micron.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: For now, demand for data centers is facing major competition, especially from PCs, smartphones, and other electronics, for limited memory supplies (and may be nowhere close to peaking). High-bandwidth memory (HBM), a specialized form of DRAM used in AI devices, has become particularly important as companies deploy increasingly powerful computing systems.Samsung and SK Hynix are among the world's leading memory manufacturers, giving South Korea a central role in supplying the hardware behind the AI expansion. According to Counterpoint Research, both companies controlled about 63% of global DRAM revenues in the second quarter of 2026. Their influence is greater in HBM, where the two South Korean manufacturers accounted for roughly 83% of global revenue. This has prompted other technology executives to approach the country, with AMD CEO Lisa Su visiting earlier this month to discuss securing additional HBM supplies from SAMSUNG, saying, "It is important to plan three to five years ahead with our partners." However, those particular upgrades concern NAND flash production, rather than DRAM — but they show just how manufacturers are adjusting capacity as demand shifts towards data center hardware. items.titleZh: 山姆·奥特曼会见三星领导层，在严重短缺之际为数据中心争取更多内存
items.descriptionZh:
OpenAI首席执行官Sam Altman近日在韩国与约50名三星高管会面，寻求扩大人工智能和内存供应能力。会议在三星位于龙仁的资源开发中心举行，三星金融、电子和生物科技等业务负责人参加。三星确认，双方讨论了加强既有合作关系，尤其是此前签署的意向书，内容涉及在全球AI基础设施上合作，包括为OpenAI的“Stargate”项目供应存储半导体。不过，三星更强调AI转型和未来商业机会，并未宣布新的内存供应协议。据报道，Altman还向三星AI中心负责人赠送了用于OpenAI编程智能体的Codex Micro Keyboard。

此次会面的背景是AI数据中心需求持续飙升、内存供应日益紧张。Altman此前在播客中称，个人电脑中的DRAM往往未被充分利用，“相当糟糕”，并建议数据中心通过在不同AI工作负载之间共享计算资源，更密集地使用内存。这一观点引发批评，因为ChatGPT等服务本身高度依赖集中式计算基础设施。更重要的是，PC中的通用DRAM与AI数据中心使用的高带宽内存（HBM）在带宽、功耗、封装和可靠性要求上并不相同，不能简单互相替代。

从技术看，HBM是面向AI加速器的专用DRAM，通过垂直堆叠DRAM芯片、硅通孔和宽接口，在靠近GPU的位置提供远高于传统DRAM的带宽和能效，是缓解“内存墙”的关键器件。随着大模型训练和推理规模扩大，HBM及数据中心DRAM成为AI基础设施扩张的核心瓶颈之一。OpenAI的Stargate项目若按计划推进，需要大规模服务器、加速器和存储资源，因而与三星、SK海力士等内存厂商的供应链关系至关重要。

市场数据凸显短缺程度。原文引用的AMD预测称，DRAM收入将在2026年增长177%，达到约4160亿美元；TrendForce估计当年DRAM供应将比需求少1%—2%，并预计2027年失衡加剧；美光则警告，新制造产能需要时间，短缺可能持续到2028年。与此同时，数据中心正与PC、智能手机等电子设备争夺有限的内存供应，且需求可能远未达峰。

韩国在全球内存供应链中处于中心位置。Counterpoint Research数据显示，2026年第二季度三星和SK海力士合计占全球DRAM收入约63%；在HBM领域，两家韩国厂商合计占全球收入约83%。AMD CEO Lisa Su本月也访问韩国，讨论从三星获得更多HBM供应，并强调需要与合作伙伴提前三到五年规划。三星和SK海力士还在升级中国工厂以生产先进存储产品，以应对AI数据中心竞争；不过原文指出，这些升级主要涉及NAND闪存而非DRAM，但仍反映出厂商正随需求结构变化调整产能。

总体而言，Altman与三星高层的会面表明，OpenAI正试图在AI算力扩张之前锁定内存供应链和产业合作关系。其“提高内存利用率、共享计算资源”的主张提供了降低浪费的思路，但难以替代HBM等专用内存的新增供给。短期看，AI数据中心对DRAM和HBM的强劲需求将继续加剧与消费电子争夺产能的局面；中长期看，三星、SK海力士的扩产节奏、HBM技术演进以及Stargate等超大规模项目的落地进度，将共同决定全球AI基础设施的成本和扩张速度。

items.title: Open-source USB tool unlocks Nvidia's half-speed GPU AI limiter on Windows
items.description: An open-source UEFI tool, nv-uefi-unlocker, lifts Nvidia’s tensor rate cap on RTX 20, 30, and 40-series GPUs under Windows.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 2 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter A new open-source UEFI tool boots from USB and unlocks significant extra tensor performance on RTX 20, 30, and 40-series desktop and laptop GPUs, making the half-speed AI throttle hack a whole lot easier to try on Windows. No VBIOS flash or patched driver needed: the tool runs from a FAT32 stick before the Nvidia driver loads at every boot, and then voila, the developer’s own laptop RTX 4060 hit 65% higher FP16 math.The “UEFI pre-driver NVIDIA GPU unlocker,” or nv-uefi-unlocker project, removes Nvidia’s tensor limiter using the community V67 payload with read-back verification. This tricks Nvidia’s signed Booter firmware into opening the write lock on two speed-selector registers, allowing the tensor units to run at full rate. The unlock can now run entirely from a bootable USB drive, on Windows as well as Linux, whereas previously it worked primarily through manually installed Linux modules, with Windows support only experimental. The read-back verification part makes things safer, which was a concern with the experimental builds. (Image credit: steppergg/GitHub)The release ships only scripts and self-built binaries, without any Nvidia firmware in the download. Instead, one of the scripts grabs Nvidia’s public 610.43.03 driver packages, verifies them, then rebuilds the firmware files locally. The project credits Zagitta’s gpu-unlock as its porting source and builds on several other community projects, including the RTX 40 fork gpu-unlock-ada and an earlier Windows EFI tool. Having one tool for the many GeForce owners on Windows should significantly open up the hack to a wider audience. Previously, it was scarier-looking, and project progression is rapid these days with AI tools.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The steps right now involve downloading the release, running that script, and then copying the rebuilt files and a BOOTX64.EFI for booting to a FAT32-formatted USB stick. The unlocker can then be run from a one-time boot menu by using the spacebar within 30 seconds for confirmation. Once complete, things are handed off to the respective OS loader.The unlocker runs in a firmware stage before the OS loads Nvidia’s GPU driver, which means there’s no need to flash the card’s video BIOS or to modify the driver; as the FAQ puts it, the unlock doesn’t “persist through power loss.” The trade-off is running it again on every boot. The system must be booted in UEFI mode with Secure Boot either off or set to trust a self-signed EFI. For a game’s anti-cheat that requires Secure Boot, the tool “CANNOT bypass this requirement,” a developer team member relayed on Reddit. RTX 20 owners have to run a bundled script once to switch the Windows Nvidia driver into GSP firmware mode, before restarting. You may like Nvidia RTX 20, 30, and 40-series GPUs hacked to remove a half-speed AI throttle Developer vibe codes a tool to let Nvidia RTX 50-series laptop owners crank up their power limits Nvidia app update fails to block unofficial DLSS multi-frame generation mod on RTX 40 series gaming GPUs Laptop GPUs were already supported by earlier projects, but here one of the developer’s own test cards is a laptop GPU, and laptop results are logged card by card. For laptops, the discrete Nvidia GPU must be powered at entry, which means dGPU-only, or MUX, mode is recommended. On Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, runtime power management can power down the GPU when idle and silently erase the unlock. The English FAQ covers workarounds for this, with instructions and guidelines for other situations.Compatibility otherwise includes RTX 20-series support listed as “fully compatible; some models have known issues,” while RTX 30-series cards are “fully compatible,” and the tool is “fully compatible on laptops and desktops” using RTX 40-series cards. The GTX 16 is “theoretically compatible” with verification pending, but other cards, including pre-Turing, the GA100, and RTX 50-series cards, are unsupported. The project routes support by chip family, so a card being covered doesn’t mean that specific card has been tested. LHR), 3060 Ti, 3060 12GB, 3080 Ti Laptop, 3070 Laptop RTX 3050 untested; persistence on Thunderbolt eGPUs not guaranteed RTX 40 (Ada Lovelace) RTX 4090, 4080, 4070 Ti Super, 4070 Super, 4070, 4060 Ti 8GB and 16GB, 4060 Laptop, 4050 Laptop RTX 4070 Laptop untested RTX 50 (Blackwell) None Not supported Results compare each card before and after the unlock on the same test, but the tests differ from row to row, so they shouldn’t be compared across cards. Swipe to scroll horizontally Reported Windows results with nv-uefi-unlocker Card Test (FP32 accumulate) Stock (TFLOPS) Unlocked (TFLOPS) Gain Who measured RTX 2070 FP16 matrix multiply 36 60–63 +67–75% Developer RTX 3060 12GB FP16 matrix multiply, 4096 25.37 45.79 1.80x Owner report RTX 3070 Laptop FP16 matrix multiply, 8192 35.43 56.04 1.58x Owner report RTX 4060 Laptop FP16 matrix multiply 29.89 49.33 1.65x Developer RTX 4080 BF16 matrix multiply, 4096 100.37 192.18 1.91x Owner report RTX 4090 FP16 matrix multiply, 4096 118.42 171.52 1.45x (power-limited) Owner report The developer’s own desktop RTX 2070 went from about 34 TFLOPS in FP16 matrix multiply at 8192 to around 62 TFLOPS in the screenshots below. Image 1 of 2 (Image credit: physicsdolphin/GitHub) (Image credit: physicsdolphin/GitHub) Image 1 of 2 View Original Image 2 of 2 View Original Some caveats still exist, and Zagitta, whose gpu-unlock kicked off the GeForce unlocks, now says in its FAQ that “I don’t run windows and don’t plan to maintain it,” pointing Windows users to a separate port and warning to be careful with unofficial Windows installers. Results from the unlock are also contingent on power and thermal limits. The new project says it can be combined with the nvoc power-limit unlock, but warns this “can exceed factory power and thermal envelopes.” A per-card ROM hash check, which the project’s own safety rules require, isn’t built yet, and the unlock’s persistence on Thunderbolt eGPUs “is not guaranteed.”Other cards, including the RTX 2080 and the RTX 2080 Ti, are under review. No dates are promised. The pro-card tensor feature can now be unlocked for many, though, and as simply as using a USB boot drive, which will get even easier with a boot-from-disk toggle the team says is in the works. RTX 50-series owners have to wait, for now, as the team is still trying to crack those cards, which have “a lot more security” than it anticipated. items.titleZh: Open-source USB tool unlocks Nvidia's half-speed GPU AI limiter on Windows
items.descriptionZh:
一款名为“UEFI pre-driver NVIDIA GPU unlocker”（nv-uefi-unlocker）的新开源工具，能够通过USB启动，在NVIDIA显卡驱动加载之前解除RTX 20、30、40系列桌面和笔记本GPU的张量性能限制，使GeForce显卡上原本被限制为半速的AI张量计算恢复全速运行。此前类似解锁主要依赖手动安装的Linux模块，Windows支持仅处于实验阶段；新工具让Windows用户也能以更低门槛尝试，无需刷写VBIOS，也无需修改或打补丁显卡驱动。

该工具的核心原理是利用社区提供的V67 payload，并加入回读验证，诱使NVIDIA签名的Booter固件打开两个速度选择寄存器的写锁，从而让张量单元以全速运行。解锁发生在操作系统加载NVIDIA GPU驱动之前的固件阶段，因此不需要改动显卡视频BIOS或驱动。代价是解锁“不会在断电后保留”，每次开机都需重新运行。使用条件包括：系统必须以UEFI模式启动，Secure Boot需关闭或设置为信任自签名EFI；对于要求Secure Boot的游戏反作弊，该工具“无法绕过这一要求”。RTX 20系列用户还需先运行捆绑脚本，将Windows下的NVIDIA驱动切换到GSP固件模式并重启。笔记本方面，独立NVIDIA GPU必须在开机时供电，推荐使用独显直连或MUX模式；在Ubuntu等Linux发行版上，运行时电源管理可能在GPU空闲时下电并静默清除解锁，FAQ提供了规避方法。

发布包只包含脚本和自行构建的二进制文件，不包含任何NVIDIA固件。其中一个脚本会下载NVIDIA公开的610.43.03驱动包，验证后在本地重建固件文件。项目致谢Zagitta的gpu-unlock作为移植来源，并建立在RTX 40分支gpu-unlock-ada及更早Windows EFI工具等社区项目之上。使用步骤大致为：下载发布包、运行脚本、将重建文件和用于启动的BOOTX64.EFI复制到FAT32格式U盘；开机时通过一次性启动菜单进入，并在30秒内按空格确认，随后将控制权交给对应操作系统的加载器。团队还计划加入“从磁盘启动”的切换选项，以进一步简化操作。

兼容性方面，RTX 20系列被列为“完全兼容，部分型号有已知问题”；RTX 30系列“完全兼容”；RTX 40系列在笔记本和桌面上“完全兼容”。GTX 16系列“理论上兼容”，尚待验证；pre-Turing、GA100和RTX 50系列不受支持。项目按芯片家族提供支持，因此某卡所属家族被覆盖并不意味着该具体型号已经测试。已确认在Windows上运行的型号包括：RTX 2070、RTX 2060 Super；RTX 3080（含LHR）、3060 Ti、3060 12GB、3080 Ti Laptop、3070 Laptop；RTX 4090、4080、4070 Ti Super、4070 Super、4070、4060 Ti 8GB和16GB、4060 Laptop、4050 Laptop。已知问题或未测试项包括：RTX 2080、2080 Ti和2080 Super在启动或交接阶段失败；GTX 16未测试；RTX 3050未测试，Thunderbolt外接GPU的持久性不保证；RTX 4070 Laptop未测试。RTX 2080和2080 Ti仍在审查中，未承诺时间表。RTX 50系列因“安全机制比预期多得多”，团队仍在尝试破解。

性能数据方面，各卡测试项目不同，不能跨卡直接比较。开发者测得RTX 2070的FP16矩阵乘从36 TFLOPS提升至60—63 TFLOPS，增幅67%—75%；用户报告RTX 3060 12GB从25.37提升至45.79 TFLOPS，约1.80倍；RTX 3070 Laptop从35.43提升至56.04 TFLOPS，约1.58倍；开发者测得RTX 4060 Laptop从29.89提升至49.33 TFLOPS，约1.65倍；用户报告RTX 4080的BF16矩阵乘从100.37提升至192.18 TFLOPS，约1.91倍；RTX 4090的FP16矩阵乘从118.42提升至171.52 TFLOPS，约1.45倍，且受功耗限制。开发者自己的桌面RTX 2070在FP16矩阵乘8192测试中从约34 TFLOPS提升至约62 TFLOPS。实际收益仍受功耗和散热上限约束；该解锁可与nvoc功耗上限解锁结合，但项目警告这可能超出工厂功耗和散热包络。项目安全规则要求的逐卡ROM哈希检查尚未内置，Thunderbolt外接GPU上的解锁持久性也不保证。Zagitta本人表示不运行Windows、也不计划维护Windows，已将Windows用户引向单独移植版本，并提醒谨慎对待非官方Windows安装器。

总体来看，该工具的意义在于把原本复杂、风险感较强的GeForce张量解锁流程简化为U盘启动操作，显著扩大了Windows GeForce用户的尝试范围，尤其适合需要FP16/BF16矩阵乘等AI张量计算的人群。不过它并非永久修改，需每次启动执行，且受Secure Boot、反作弊、功耗散热、笔记本供电模式和具体型号兼容性等因素制约。RTX 50系列用户暂时仍需等待。

items.title: AI agent swarms unleashed in Minecraft to ‘build a thriving civilization’
items.description: Researchers recently tested AI agent swarm performance in various Minecraft gaming modes.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter AI researchers at ycombinator and Olam Labs recently tested AI agent swarms in gaming scenarios. Minecraft and its various game modes were the sandboxes where 100s of agents were unleashed to work together or as adversaries. The idea seems to be that the in-game collaborations and conflicts would provide insight into real-world headline-grabbing cases with AI agents involved.This study might help us see what happened, good and bad, in recent AI swarm cases, and thus developers of this technology can improve it. The blog mentions two contrasting cases, which were the thousand-agent swarms that “recently obliterated hundreds of open mathematical problems,” and the “extremely dangerous” OpenAI-Hugging Face incident. This research is built on prior work and frameworks, specifically repos like Mindcraft and scripting tools in Mineflayer.Multi-agent dynamics in MinecraftThe first AI swarm testing plan was a simple collaborative one. During this test phase, the researchers tasked 50 agents with building a thriving civilization in three hours. It seems to have tested 50 GPT-6.1 Sol agents here, but not any Claude agents.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Probably the most interesting insight from this ‘Civ50’ test was that the 50-strong colony never really thrived. After the first night saw zombies take out a large number of agents (but with little penalty) it was noted that “many ambitious initial tasks were abandoned.” From then on, the colonists cautiously survived, and there was a tendency toward bureaucracy. As an example, “four agents spent 11 minutes appointing a ‘sole fertilizer operator’ for a single piece of bone meal on a single wheat block.” The researchers say this AI agent swarm behavior “felt similar to patterns seen while working with coding agents.” (Image credit: ycombinator)Next up, the researchers decided to put AI agent swarms into conflict. First they tested them in Bed Wars, which is a kind of team PvP capture the base, while defending yours game mode. The setup was 10 GPT‑6.1 Sol vs. 10 Claude Opus 5.5 agents.“GPT agents came up with much more aggressive and elaborate strategies,” noted the researchers. Claude was more defensive. It was also interesting to observe contrasts in how the teams handled problems. “A tool bug stopped block-breaking. GPT diagnosed it and shared workarounds; several Claudes concluded breaking was impossible.”Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsFinally, the agents were tested in Mindustry, a kind of light RTS combat game with tower defense mode in Minecraft. “The GPTs won 6-1 against the Claudes in the 7 games,” which was a great result for the OpenAI-created agents. Researchers concluded that GPTs acted more like a hive, while Claudes had a single leader but a democratic-style decision process. In Mindustry, the former was the foundation for a more consistently winning strategy.These swarms are open sourced so you can run your own, if you are interested in tweaking and testing. The source blog post ends with some open questions that you can check hands-on, offering some directions for investigative probing. For example, it is suggested that comparing different mixes of models and varying sizes of agent swarms in Minecraft might raise worthwhile conclusions. items.author: Mark Tyson
items.titleZh: AI智能体集群在《我的世界》中登场，要“建设繁荣文明”
items.descriptionZh:
AI 研究机构 Y Combinator 与 Olam Labs 的研究人员最近在游戏场景中测试了 AI 智能体集群（agent swarms），让数百个智能体在《我的世界》（Minecraft）及其多种游戏模式中协同或对抗。研究者的出发点是：游戏内的合作与冲突可以提供一个可控的沙盒，用来观察和解释现实世界中那些引人注目的 AI 智能体集群事件，进而帮助开发者理解其中哪些行为是有效的、哪些是危险的，并据此改进技术。

这一研究建立在已有工作和框架之上，尤其是 Mindcraft 代码库以及 Mineflayer 中的脚本工具。简单来说，研究者让大语言模型驱动的智能体接入 Minecraft 环境，通过脚本接口感知游戏状态、执行移动、采集、建造、战斗等动作，并在多智能体之间进行沟通与协调。与单一智能体测试相比，集群测试的重点不是某个模型能否完成特定任务，而是多个智能体在开放环境中的组织方式、分工效率、冲突处理以及故障应对能力。文章提到两个对比鲜明的现实案例作为背景：其一是“最近解决了数百个开放数学问题”的千智能体集群，其二是“极其危险”的 OpenAI-Hugging Face 事件。前者展示了大规模协作的潜力，后者则提示多智能体系统可能带来失控风险，因此需要在可观测、可重复的环境中研究其行为规律。

第一组实验名为“Civ50”，目标是让 50 个智能体在 3 小时内建立繁荣文明。实验使用的是 50 个 GPT-6.1 Sol 智能体，没有加入 Claude 模型。结果并不理想：殖民地在第一个夜晚遭到僵尸攻击，大量智能体被消灭，不过惩罚很小；此后许多雄心勃勃的初始任务被放弃，智能体转向谨慎求生，并出现明显的官僚化倾向。研究者举例说，四个智能体花了 11 分钟，只为一块小麦上的单份骨粉任命一名“唯一肥料操作员”。研究者认为，这种集群行为“与使用编程智能体时看到的模式相似”，说明多智能体系统在目标分解、职责分配和流程管理上可能出现过度协调、效率低下的问题。

随后，研究者把智能体集群放入对抗场景。首先测试的是 Bed Wars，一种团队 PvP 的夺旗守基地模式，阵容为 10 个 GPT-6.1 Sol 对 10 个 Claude Opus 5.5。研究者观察到，GPT 智能体提出了更具攻击性和更精细的策略，Claude 一方则更偏防御。双方在问题处理上的差异也很明显：当一个工具 bug 导致无法破坏方块时，GPT 智能体诊断出问题并分享了变通方法，而多个 Claude 智能体则得出结论认为“破坏方块不可能”。这反映出不同模型在工具故障诊断、信息共享和集体决策上的差异。

最后，研究者在 Mindustry 中测试了智能体集群。文章将其描述为一种轻量级即时战略战斗游戏，并带有塔防模式。在 7 局比赛中，GPT 一方以 6 比 1 战胜 Claude 一方。研究者总结认为，GPT 智能体更像“蜂群”式协作，而 Claude 智能体虽然只有一个领导者，但采用民主式决策过程；在 Mindustry 中，前一种组织方式成为更稳定获胜策略的基础。这一结果并不是简单的模型能力排名，而是说明多智能体的协调拓扑结构会显著影响整体表现：集中式决策可能更稳健，分布式蜂群式协作则可能在动态对抗中更具适应性和攻击性。

这项研究的价值在于，它把多智能体系统的组织行为、故障恢复和策略差异放进了可重复、可开源的测试环境中。相关集群已经开源，感兴趣的人可以自行运行、调整和测试。博客最后提出了一些开放问题，例如比较不同模型组合以及不同规模的智能体集群在 Minecraft 中的表现，可能得出有价值的结论。对于现实应用而言，这类研究有助于理解多智能体在编程协作、自动化运维、游戏 AI、复杂任务分解等场景中的失效模式，也为设计更可靠、更可观测的智能体集群提供参考。不过，游戏环境毕竟经过简化，实验规模、模型种类和惩罚机制都有限，结论仍需更多系统性测试来验证。

history.title: Biwin M560 2TB SSD Review: The DRAM-less drive to beat
history.description: The Biwin M560 brings SMI’s SM2504XT to retail with top-tier responsiveness and excellent efficiency, though not the fastest post-cache writes.
history.content: We’re back with another drive from Biwin, which has been putting out some good SSDs with minor exceptions. This one uses hardware we’ve wanted to test in retail for quite some time: the SMI SM2504XT SSD controller, which is hard to find. The PCIe 5.0 DRAM-less range is relatively popular because it offers the performance without the power and heat of higher-end options, at a lower price point. The tech’s newer than what PCIe 4.0 drives offer, so you get a better all-around experience if you’re willing to take the plunge. The M560 slots in here perfectly as a real alternative to all the drives in this class with Phison hardware.Biwin M560 Specifications Swipe to scroll horizontally Product 1TB 2TB Pricing $189.99 $364.99 Form Factor M.2 2280 (Single-sided) M.2 2280 (Single-sided) Interface / Protocol PCIe 5.0 x4 / NVMe 2.0 PCIe 5.0 x4 / NVMe 2.0 Controller SMI SM2504XT SMI SM2504XT DRAM DRAM-less / HMB DRAM-less / HMB Memory 218-layer BiCS8 TLC (Kioxia) 218-layer BiCS8 TLC (Kioxia) Sequential Read 11,000 MB/s 11,000 MB/s Sequential Write 9,700 MB/s 10,000 MB/s Random Read 1,400K 1,700K Random Write 1,600K 1,700K Security N/A N/A Endurance (TBW) 750TB 1,500TB Part Number BM560NN01TB-RGX BM560NN02TB-RGX Height 2.45 mm 2.45 mm Warranty 5-Year 5-Year Today's best Biwin M560 2TB SSD deals $364.99View No price informationCheck Best BuyWe check over 250 million products every day for the best pricesThe Biwin M560 is available only in 1TB and 2TB capacities. Is that a disappointment? It’s normal to expect at least 4TB SKUs these days, but 8TB is certainly a bridge too far for a four-channel controller. Yes, we have some 8TB DRAM-less drives floating around, but for the most part you can’t find those units. 4TB is more common and highly desired — this is what makes the Lexar NM790 so legendary — but it actually is a decent amount of flash for this type of controller. With the ideal amount of flash for this controller being four dies per channel, or 16 total, 2TB really is the sweet spot. So we’re fine with that for this drive, even if it is higher-end.Biwin M560 2TB SSD (2TB SSD) at Amazon for $364.99Right now the drive can be found for $189.99 and $364.99 for the two SKUs, which is not unreasonably priced for the hardware. At 2TB, it is right in line with the Crucial P510, for example. It’s also below the top drives with DRAM, like the Samsung 9100 Pro, by enough that it makes sense. You can get PCIe 5.0 DRAM SSDs at around this price or cheaper, but you’re giving up some things to do so, which we’ll get into later.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The drive is rated for up to 11,000 / 10,000 MB/s for sequential reads and writes and up to a whopping 1,700K / 1,700K random read and write IOPS. 1.7 million IOPS! That’s astounding, and even exceeds the 1.3+ million, on paper, from direct competitor Phison E31T-based drives, like the Corsair MP700 Elite. This thing is a beast for a DRAM-less drive.Biwin doesn’t skimp on the warranty, either. It’s the typical five-year affair for duration, but you’re covered for up to 750TB of writes for every TB of space. This is 25% more than is typical, if you care about that sort of thing. We consider it a bonus.Biwin M560 Software and AccessoriesHitting the download tab for the M560’s site shows three downloads available: the Biwin Data Recovery Tool for macOS, one for Windows, and Biwin Intelligence. The first two are pretty self-explanatory, but we will give kudos to Biwin for having the macOS option. For the last, it is the company’s SSD toolbox, which is an all-in-one software solution dashboard you can use to check your drive’s health, update firmware, and so forth. Biwin lists the supported functions on its page. The toolbox only supports Windows at this time.Biwin M560: A Closer Look Image 1 of 2 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Image 1 of 2 View Original Image 2 of 2 View Original The Biwin M560 is, as expected, a single-sided drive, which we prefer. Less that can go wrong, fits into more machines, and can be easier to cool. The top label is heat-spreading. The back label has drive information, including the 3.3 V / 2.0 A rating, which puts the drive power draw below about 7W. According to the S.M.A.R.T. report, the maximum power draw is 8W.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsThese numbers might be concerning, especially as good DRAM-less SSDs tend to be at around 6.5W or less. Well, as it turns out, the drive is much more comfortable at 4W, with a maximum significantly below 6.5W and an average of one-half that, as you can explore in more detail with our power testing. Even very efficient PCIe 5.0 drives tend to step up over the last generation, making heat something to watch in some cases. Not in this one — we think this will be great in laptops, and exceptionally cool in PCIe 4.0 ones. Image 1 of 3 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Image 1 of 3 View Original Image 2 of 3 View Original Image 3 of 3 View Original The components don’t even take up half of the PCB space! Impressive engineering, and the extra spacing between components can help spread heat. Here we have one controller, the SMI SM2504XT, which we previously covered in an ES preview, and two NAND flash packages. The controller performed exceptionally in our preview testing and is more than a match for the best controllers out there, whether Phison’s competing E31T or even many drives with DRAM such as those based on the E26. The flash, in this case, is Kioxia’s 218-layer BiCS8 TLC, which is also exceptional. This flash has excellent latency and is also power-efficient. This combination is a match made in heaven, and it’s a shame we don’t see the SM2504XT more often.MORE: Best SSDsMORE: Best External SSDsMORE: Best SSD for the Steam DeckBiwin M560 2TB SSD: Price Comparison $364.99View No price informationCheck Best BuyWe check over 250 million products every day for the best pricespowered by
history.author: Shane Downing
history.titleZh: 佰维 M560 2TB SSD 评测：无DRAM缓存硬盘中的标杆
history.descriptionZh:
Biwin M560 是一款采用 PCIe 5.0 接口、无独立 DRAM 的高性能 SSD，提供 1TB 和 2TB 两种容量，定价分别为 189.99 美元和 364.99 美元。这款产品最受关注的地方，是搭载了零售市场较少见的慧荣 SM2504XT 主控，并搭配铠侠 218 层 BiCS8 TLC 闪存。当前 PCIe 5.0 DRAM-less SSD 之所以逐渐流行，是因为它们能在较低价格下提供接近高端产品的性能，同时避免高端 PCIe 5.0 盘常见的较高功耗和发热。M560 的定位正是这一类别中采用 Phison 硬件之外的一个有竞争力的替代选择。

从技术原理看，M560 采用 DRAM-less 设计，通过 HMB（Host Memory Buffer，主机内存缓冲）借用系统内存来维护映射表等数据，从而省去独立 DRAM 芯片，降低成本和功耗。它使用四通道的 SM2504XT 主控，文章指出这类控制器较理想的闪存配置是每通道 4 个 die、总共 16 个 die，因此 2TB 容量正好处在一个较优的甜点位置。虽然缺少 4TB 选项略显遗憾，但 8TB 对四通道控制器并不现实，2TB 在性能和容量之间较为均衡。闪存方面，铠侠 218 层 BiCS8 TLC 具备较好的延迟表现和能效，与 SM2504XT 组合后形成了非常出色的搭配。文章甚至认为，这套组合堪称“天作之合”，并遗憾 SM2504XT 在零售产品中不够常见。

性能参数方面，M560 标称顺序读取最高 11,000 MB/s；顺序写入 1TB 为 9,700 MB/s，2TB 为 10,000 MB/s。随机性能方面，1TB 为 1,400K 随机读取和 1,600K 随机写入 IOPS，2TB 则达到 1,700K / 1,700K IOPS。1.7M IOPS 对一款 DRAM-less 产品来说非常惊人，纸面上甚至超过直接竞争对手——采用 Phison E31T 的 Corsair MP700 Elite 等产品所标称的 130 万+ IOPS。文章认为，SM2504XT 的性能足以匹敌市面上最好的主控之一，不仅能对抗 Phison E31T，也能与不少带 DRAM 的方案，包括基于 E26 的 SSD 竞争。价格上，2TB 版与 Crucial P510 基本处于同一水平，同时明显低于 Samsung 9100 Pro 等带 DRAM 的旗舰产品；市场上虽然也能找到同价甚至更便宜的 PCIe 5.0 带 DRAM SSD，但通常会在某些方面有所妥协。

在设计与功耗方面，M560 采用单面 M.2 2280 形态，文章更偏好这种设计，因为它更少出错、兼容更多设备，也更容易散热。顶部标签具有导热/均热作用，背面标签标注了 3.3V / 2.0A 的供电规格，对应功耗低于约 7W；S.M.A.R.T. 报告显示最大功耗为 8W。不过实际测试中，该盘在 4W 左右更舒适，最大功耗显著低于 6.5W，平均功耗约为其一半。对于一款高性能 PCIe 5.0 SSD 来说，这样的能效表现相当突出，文章认为它非常适合笔记本电脑，在 PCIe 4.0 平台上也会非常凉爽。其 PCB 上元件占用不到一半空间，元件之间留有较大间距，有助于分散热量。保修方面，M560 提供 5 年质保，且每 TB 容量对应 750TBW 写入耐久度，比常见水平高约 25%。软件方面，Biwin 提供 macOS 和 Windows 版数据恢复工具，以及目前仅支持 Windows 的 Biwin Intelligence SSD 工具箱，可用于查看健康状态、更新固件等。

总体来看，Biwin M560 的意义在于把零售市场难得一见的 SM2504XT 主控与高能效的铠侠 BiCS8 TLC 闪存结合起来，在 DRAM-less PCIe 5.0 产品中实现了很强的顺序和随机性能，同时保持较低功耗和单面设计。它适合追求高性能但重视能效、发热和兼容性的用户，尤其是笔记本和 PCIe 4.0 平台用户；其容量选择集中在 1TB 和 2TB，也符合四通道控制器的合理区间。对于希望避开 Phison E31T 方案、寻找同级替代品的消费者来说，M560 提供了一个有吸引力的新选择。

history.title: Sam Altman meets with Samsung leadership to secure more RAM for data centers amid crushing shortages
history.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman met with around 50 Samsung executives in South Korea on October 31 to discuss AI's future, business opportunities and the technology's impact on corporate operations. The meeting comes as demand for memory chips grows alongside AI infrastructure spending, putting pressure on global DRAM supplies. Samsung and SK hynix together accounted for approximately 83% of global high-bandwidth memory revenue in the second quarter of 2026, highlighting South Korea's central role in supplying the hardware behind the AI expansion.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 4 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has met with about 50 senior Samsung executives in South Korea, as the company seeks to expand its Artificial Intelligence and memory capacity, Bloomberg reports. Altman’s visit to South Korea follows his recent comments about how the world's limited memory supply should be allocated. In an interview on the Chick Pink podcast this week, the OpenAI chief argued that DRAM sitting inside personal computers is often underused, describing it as “quite terrible”. He suggested that data centers could make more intensive use of memory by sharing computer resources across AI workloads. The argument has drawn widespread criticism given OpenAI’s own services like ChatGPT rely heavily on centralized computing infrastructure.The meeting, which took place at Samsung’s Resources Development Center in Yongin on Saturday, October 30, brought together chiefs from the company’s financial, electronics, and biotechnology businesses. Confirming the meeting, Samsung Korea said the discussion revolved around strengthening existing relationships between the two companies, particularly a letter of Intent signed in October 20225 to cooperate on global AI infrastructure, including supplying memory semiconductors for OpenAI’s Stargate project. “The Samsung executives and CEO Sam Altman discussed the direction of AI technology development and its potential applications, as well as new markets and business opportunities that will emerge from it,” Samsung stated.Samsung, however, emphasized more on AI transformation and future business opportunities, rather than announcing a new memory supply agreement. Reportedly, Altman also presented Samsung’s AI Center head with a Codex Micro Keyboard, a device designed for use with OpenAI’s coding agent. The latest meeting comes as demand from AI centers continues to soar, with AMD forecasting DRAM revenue will jump 177% in 2026 to about $416 billion. Trendforce also estimates DRAM supply will fall 1% to 2% short of demand this year, with the imbalance expected to worsen in 2027. New manufacturing capacity may take time to come, which means the shortage could persist into 2028, as per a recent warning by Micron.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: For now, demand for data centers is facing major competition, especially from PCs, smartphones, and other electronics, for limited memory supplies (and may be nowhere close to peaking). High-bandwidth memory (HBM), a specialized form of DRAM used in AI devices, has become particularly important as companies deploy increasingly powerful computing systems.Samsung and SK Hynix are among the world's leading memory manufacturers, giving South Korea a central role in supplying the hardware behind the AI expansion. According to Counterpoint Research, both companies controlled about 63% of global DRAM revenues in the second quarter of 2026. Their influence is greater in HBM, where the two South Korean manufacturers accounted for roughly 83% of global revenue. This has prompted other technology executives to approach the country, with AMD CEO Lisa Su visiting earlier this month to discuss securing additional HBM supplies from SAMSUNG, saying, "It is important to plan three to five years ahead with our partners." However, those particular upgrades concern NAND flash production, rather than DRAM — but they show just how manufacturers are adjusting capacity as demand shifts towards data center hardware. history.titleZh: 山姆·奥特曼会见三星领导层，在严重短缺之际为数据中心争取更多内存
history.descriptionZh:
OpenAI首席执行官Sam Altman近日在韩国与约50名三星高管会面，寻求扩大人工智能和内存供应能力。会议在三星位于龙仁的资源开发中心举行，三星金融、电子和生物科技等业务负责人参加。三星确认，双方讨论了加强既有合作关系，尤其是此前签署的意向书，内容涉及在全球AI基础设施上合作，包括为OpenAI的“Stargate”项目供应存储半导体。不过，三星更强调AI转型和未来商业机会，并未宣布新的内存供应协议。据报道，Altman还向三星AI中心负责人赠送了用于OpenAI编程智能体的Codex Micro Keyboard。

此次会面的背景是AI数据中心需求持续飙升、内存供应日益紧张。Altman此前在播客中称，个人电脑中的DRAM往往未被充分利用，“相当糟糕”，并建议数据中心通过在不同AI工作负载之间共享计算资源，更密集地使用内存。这一观点引发批评，因为ChatGPT等服务本身高度依赖集中式计算基础设施。更重要的是，PC中的通用DRAM与AI数据中心使用的高带宽内存（HBM）在带宽、功耗、封装和可靠性要求上并不相同，不能简单互相替代。

从技术看，HBM是面向AI加速器的专用DRAM，通过垂直堆叠DRAM芯片、硅通孔和宽接口，在靠近GPU的位置提供远高于传统DRAM的带宽和能效，是缓解“内存墙”的关键器件。随着大模型训练和推理规模扩大，HBM及数据中心DRAM成为AI基础设施扩张的核心瓶颈之一。OpenAI的Stargate项目若按计划推进，需要大规模服务器、加速器和存储资源，因而与三星、SK海力士等内存厂商的供应链关系至关重要。

市场数据凸显短缺程度。原文引用的AMD预测称，DRAM收入将在2026年增长177%，达到约4160亿美元；TrendForce估计当年DRAM供应将比需求少1%—2%，并预计2027年失衡加剧；美光则警告，新制造产能需要时间，短缺可能持续到2028年。与此同时，数据中心正与PC、智能手机等电子设备争夺有限的内存供应，且需求可能远未达峰。

韩国在全球内存供应链中处于中心位置。Counterpoint Research数据显示，2026年第二季度三星和SK海力士合计占全球DRAM收入约63%；在HBM领域，两家韩国厂商合计占全球收入约83%。AMD CEO Lisa Su本月也访问韩国，讨论从三星获得更多HBM供应，并强调需要与合作伙伴提前三到五年规划。三星和SK海力士还在升级中国工厂以生产先进存储产品，以应对AI数据中心竞争；不过原文指出，这些升级主要涉及NAND闪存而非DRAM，但仍反映出厂商正随需求结构变化调整产能。

总体而言，Altman与三星高层的会面表明，OpenAI正试图在AI算力扩张之前锁定内存供应链和产业合作关系。其“提高内存利用率、共享计算资源”的主张提供了降低浪费的思路，但难以替代HBM等专用内存的新增供给。短期看，AI数据中心对DRAM和HBM的强劲需求将继续加剧与消费电子争夺产能的局面；中长期看，三星、SK海力士的扩产节奏、HBM技术演进以及Stargate等超大规模项目的落地进度，将共同决定全球AI基础设施的成本和扩张速度。

history.title: Open-source USB tool unlocks Nvidia's half-speed GPU AI limiter on Windows
history.description: An open-source UEFI tool, nv-uefi-unlocker, lifts Nvidia’s tensor rate cap on RTX 20, 30, and 40-series GPUs under Windows.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 2 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter A new open-source UEFI tool boots from USB and unlocks significant extra tensor performance on RTX 20, 30, and 40-series desktop and laptop GPUs, making the half-speed AI throttle hack a whole lot easier to try on Windows. No VBIOS flash or patched driver needed: the tool runs from a FAT32 stick before the Nvidia driver loads at every boot, and then voila, the developer’s own laptop RTX 4060 hit 65% higher FP16 math.The “UEFI pre-driver NVIDIA GPU unlocker,” or nv-uefi-unlocker project, removes Nvidia’s tensor limiter using the community V67 payload with read-back verification. This tricks Nvidia’s signed Booter firmware into opening the write lock on two speed-selector registers, allowing the tensor units to run at full rate. The unlock can now run entirely from a bootable USB drive, on Windows as well as Linux, whereas previously it worked primarily through manually installed Linux modules, with Windows support only experimental. The read-back verification part makes things safer, which was a concern with the experimental builds. (Image credit: steppergg/GitHub)The release ships only scripts and self-built binaries, without any Nvidia firmware in the download. Instead, one of the scripts grabs Nvidia’s public 610.43.03 driver packages, verifies them, then rebuilds the firmware files locally. The project credits Zagitta’s gpu-unlock as its porting source and builds on several other community projects, including the RTX 40 fork gpu-unlock-ada and an earlier Windows EFI tool. Having one tool for the many GeForce owners on Windows should significantly open up the hack to a wider audience. Previously, it was scarier-looking, and project progression is rapid these days with AI tools.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The steps right now involve downloading the release, running that script, and then copying the rebuilt files and a BOOTX64.EFI for booting to a FAT32-formatted USB stick. The unlocker can then be run from a one-time boot menu by using the spacebar within 30 seconds for confirmation. Once complete, things are handed off to the respective OS loader.The unlocker runs in a firmware stage before the OS loads Nvidia’s GPU driver, which means there’s no need to flash the card’s video BIOS or to modify the driver; as the FAQ puts it, the unlock doesn’t “persist through power loss.” The trade-off is running it again on every boot. The system must be booted in UEFI mode with Secure Boot either off or set to trust a self-signed EFI. For a game’s anti-cheat that requires Secure Boot, the tool “CANNOT bypass this requirement,” a developer team member relayed on Reddit. RTX 20 owners have to run a bundled script once to switch the Windows Nvidia driver into GSP firmware mode, before restarting. You may like Nvidia RTX 20, 30, and 40-series GPUs hacked to remove a half-speed AI throttle Developer vibe codes a tool to let Nvidia RTX 50-series laptop owners crank up their power limits Nvidia app update fails to block unofficial DLSS multi-frame generation mod on RTX 40 series gaming GPUs Laptop GPUs were already supported by earlier projects, but here one of the developer’s own test cards is a laptop GPU, and laptop results are logged card by card. For laptops, the discrete Nvidia GPU must be powered at entry, which means dGPU-only, or MUX, mode is recommended. On Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, runtime power management can power down the GPU when idle and silently erase the unlock. The English FAQ covers workarounds for this, with instructions and guidelines for other situations.Compatibility otherwise includes RTX 20-series support listed as “fully compatible; some models have known issues,” while RTX 30-series cards are “fully compatible,” and the tool is “fully compatible on laptops and desktops” using RTX 40-series cards. The GTX 16 is “theoretically compatible” with verification pending, but other cards, including pre-Turing, the GA100, and RTX 50-series cards, are unsupported. The project routes support by chip family, so a card being covered doesn’t mean that specific card has been tested. Image 1 of 2 (Image credit: physicsdolphin/GitHub) (Image credit: physicsdolphin/GitHub) Image 1 of 2 View Original Image 2 of 2 View Original Some caveats still exist, and Zagitta, whose gpu-unlock kicked off the GeForce unlocks, now says in its FAQ that “I don’t run windows and don’t plan to maintain it,” pointing Windows users to a separate port and warning to be careful with unofficial Windows installers. Results from the unlock are also contingent on power and thermal limits. The new project says it can be combined with the nvoc power-limit unlock, but warns this “can exceed factory power and thermal envelopes.” A per-card ROM hash check, which the project’s own safety rules require, isn’t built yet, and the unlock’s persistence on Thunderbolt eGPUs “is not guaranteed.”Other cards, including the RTX 2080 and the RTX 2080 Ti, are under review. No dates are promised. The pro-card tensor feature can now be unlocked for many, though, and as simply as using a USB boot drive, which will get even easier with a boot-from-disk toggle the team says is in the works. RTX 50-series owners have to wait, for now, as the team is still trying to crack those cards, which have “a lot more security” than it anticipated. history.titleZh: Open-source USB tool unlocks Nvidia's half-speed GPU AI limiter on Windows
history.descriptionZh:
一款名为“UEFI pre-driver NVIDIA GPU unlocker”（nv-uefi-unlocker）的新开源工具，能够通过USB启动，在NVIDIA显卡驱动加载之前解除RTX 20、30、40系列桌面和笔记本GPU的张量性能限制，使GeForce显卡上原本被限制为半速的AI张量计算恢复全速运行。此前类似解锁主要依赖手动安装的Linux模块，Windows支持仅处于实验阶段；新工具让Windows用户也能以更低门槛尝试，无需刷写VBIOS，也无需修改或打补丁显卡驱动。

该工具的核心原理是利用社区提供的V67 payload，并加入回读验证，诱使NVIDIA签名的Booter固件打开两个速度选择寄存器的写锁，从而让张量单元以全速运行。解锁发生在操作系统加载NVIDIA GPU驱动之前的固件阶段，因此不需要改动显卡视频BIOS或驱动。代价是解锁“不会在断电后保留”，每次开机都需重新运行。使用条件包括：系统必须以UEFI模式启动，Secure Boot需关闭或设置为信任自签名EFI；对于要求Secure Boot的游戏反作弊，该工具“无法绕过这一要求”。RTX 20系列用户还需先运行捆绑脚本，将Windows下的NVIDIA驱动切换到GSP固件模式并重启。笔记本方面，独立NVIDIA GPU必须在开机时供电，推荐使用独显直连或MUX模式；在Ubuntu等Linux发行版上，运行时电源管理可能在GPU空闲时下电并静默清除解锁，FAQ提供了规避方法。

发布包只包含脚本和自行构建的二进制文件，不包含任何NVIDIA固件。其中一个脚本会下载NVIDIA公开的610.43.03驱动包，验证后在本地重建固件文件。项目致谢Zagitta的gpu-unlock作为移植来源，并建立在RTX 40分支gpu-unlock-ada及更早Windows EFI工具等社区项目之上。使用步骤大致为：下载发布包、运行脚本、将重建文件和用于启动的BOOTX64.EFI复制到FAT32格式U盘；开机时通过一次性启动菜单进入，并在30秒内按空格确认，随后将控制权交给对应操作系统的加载器。团队还计划加入“从磁盘启动”的切换选项，以进一步简化操作。

兼容性方面，RTX 20系列被列为“完全兼容，部分型号有已知问题”；RTX 30系列“完全兼容”；RTX 40系列在笔记本和桌面上“完全兼容”。GTX 16系列“理论上兼容”，尚待验证；pre-Turing、GA100和RTX 50系列不受支持。项目按芯片家族提供支持，因此某卡所属家族被覆盖并不意味着该具体型号已经测试。已确认在Windows上运行的型号包括：RTX 2070、RTX 2060 Super；RTX 3080（含LHR）、3060 Ti、3060 12GB、3080 Ti Laptop、3070 Laptop；RTX 4090、4080、4070 Ti Super、4070 Super、4070、4060 Ti 8GB和16GB、4060 Laptop、4050 Laptop。已知问题或未测试项包括：RTX 2080、2080 Ti和2080 Super在启动或交接阶段失败；GTX 16未测试；RTX 3050未测试，Thunderbolt外接GPU的持久性不保证；RTX 4070 Laptop未测试。RTX 2080和2080 Ti仍在审查中，未承诺时间表。RTX 50系列因“安全机制比预期多得多”，团队仍在尝试破解。

性能数据方面，各卡测试项目不同，不能跨卡直接比较。开发者测得RTX 2070的FP16矩阵乘从36 TFLOPS提升至60—63 TFLOPS，增幅67%—75%；用户报告RTX 3060 12GB从25.37提升至45.79 TFLOPS，约1.80倍；RTX 3070 Laptop从35.43提升至56.04 TFLOPS，约1.58倍；开发者测得RTX 4060 Laptop从29.89提升至49.33 TFLOPS，约1.65倍；用户报告RTX 4080的BF16矩阵乘从100.37提升至192.18 TFLOPS，约1.91倍；RTX 4090的FP16矩阵乘从118.42提升至171.52 TFLOPS，约1.45倍，且受功耗限制。开发者自己的桌面RTX 2070在FP16矩阵乘8192测试中从约34 TFLOPS提升至约62 TFLOPS。实际收益仍受功耗和散热上限约束；该解锁可与nvoc功耗上限解锁结合，但项目警告这可能超出工厂功耗和散热包络。项目安全规则要求的逐卡ROM哈希检查尚未内置，Thunderbolt外接GPU上的解锁持久性也不保证。Zagitta本人表示不运行Windows、也不计划维护Windows，已将Windows用户引向单独移植版本，并提醒谨慎对待非官方Windows安装器。

总体来看，该工具的意义在于把原本复杂、风险感较强的GeForce张量解锁流程简化为U盘启动操作，显著扩大了Windows GeForce用户的尝试范围，尤其适合需要FP16/BF16矩阵乘等AI张量计算的人群。不过它并非永久修改，需每次启动执行，且受Secure Boot、反作弊、功耗散热、笔记本供电模式和具体型号兼容性等因素制约。RTX 50系列用户暂时仍需等待。

history.title: AI agent swarms unleashed in Minecraft to ‘build a thriving civilization’
history.description: Researchers recently tested AI agent swarm performance in various Minecraft gaming modes.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter AI researchers at ycombinator and Olam Labs recently tested AI agent swarms in gaming scenarios. Minecraft and its various game modes were the sandboxes where 100s of agents were unleashed to work together or as adversaries. The idea seems to be that the in-game collaborations and conflicts would provide insight into real-world headline-grabbing cases with AI agents involved.This study might help us see what happened, good and bad, in recent AI swarm cases, and thus developers of this technology can improve it. The blog mentions two contrasting cases, which were the thousand-agent swarms that “recently obliterated hundreds of open mathematical problems,” and the “extremely dangerous” OpenAI-Hugging Face incident. This research is built on prior work and frameworks, specifically repos like Mindcraft and scripting tools in Mineflayer.Multi-agent dynamics in MinecraftThe first AI swarm testing plan was a simple collaborative one. During this test phase, the researchers tasked 50 agents with building a thriving civilization in three hours. It seems to have tested 50 GPT-6.1 Sol agents here, but not any Claude agents.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Probably the most interesting insight from this ‘Civ50’ test was that the 50-strong colony never really thrived. After the first night saw zombies take out a large number of agents (but with little penalty) it was noted that “many ambitious initial tasks were abandoned.” From then on, the colonists cautiously survived, and there was a tendency toward bureaucracy. As an example, “four agents spent 11 minutes appointing a ‘sole fertilizer operator’ for a single piece of bone meal on a single wheat block.” The researchers say this AI agent swarm behavior “felt similar to patterns seen while working with coding agents.” (Image credit: ycombinator)Next up, the researchers decided to put AI agent swarms into conflict. First they tested them in Bed Wars, which is a kind of team PvP capture the base, while defending yours game mode. The setup was 10 GPT‑6.1 Sol vs. 10 Claude Opus 5.5 agents.“GPT agents came up with much more aggressive and elaborate strategies,” noted the researchers. Claude was more defensive. It was also interesting to observe contrasts in how the teams handled problems. “A tool bug stopped block-breaking. GPT diagnosed it and shared workarounds; several Claudes concluded breaking was impossible.”Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsFinally, the agents were tested in Mindustry, a kind of light RTS combat game with tower defense mode in Minecraft. “The GPTs won 6-1 against the Claudes in the 7 games,” which was a great result for the OpenAI-created agents. Researchers concluded that GPTs acted more like a hive, while Claudes had a single leader but a democratic-style decision process. In Mindustry, the former was the foundation for a more consistently winning strategy.These swarms are open sourced so you can run your own, if you are interested in tweaking and testing. The source blog post ends with some open questions that you can check hands-on, offering some directions for investigative probing. For example, it is suggested that comparing different mixes of models and varying sizes of agent swarms in Minecraft might raise worthwhile conclusions. history.titleZh: AI智能体集群在《我的世界》中登场，要“建设繁荣文明”
history.descriptionZh:
AI 研究机构 Y Combinator 与 Olam Labs 的研究人员最近在游戏场景中测试了 AI 智能体集群（agent swarms），让数百个智能体在《我的世界》（Minecraft）及其多种游戏模式中协同或对抗。研究者的出发点是：游戏内的合作与冲突可以提供一个可控的沙盒，用来观察和解释现实世界中那些引人注目的 AI 智能体集群事件，进而帮助开发者理解其中哪些行为是有效的、哪些是危险的，并据此改进技术。

这一研究建立在已有工作和框架之上，尤其是 Mindcraft 代码库以及 Mineflayer 中的脚本工具。简单来说，研究者让大语言模型驱动的智能体接入 Minecraft 环境，通过脚本接口感知游戏状态、执行移动、采集、建造、战斗等动作，并在多智能体之间进行沟通与协调。与单一智能体测试相比，集群测试的重点不是某个模型能否完成特定任务，而是多个智能体在开放环境中的组织方式、分工效率、冲突处理以及故障应对能力。文章提到两个对比鲜明的现实案例作为背景：其一是“最近解决了数百个开放数学问题”的千智能体集群，其二是“极其危险”的 OpenAI-Hugging Face 事件。前者展示了大规模协作的潜力，后者则提示多智能体系统可能带来失控风险，因此需要在可观测、可重复的环境中研究其行为规律。

第一组实验名为“Civ50”，目标是让 50 个智能体在 3 小时内建立繁荣文明。实验使用的是 50 个 GPT-6.1 Sol 智能体，没有加入 Claude 模型。结果并不理想：殖民地在第一个夜晚遭到僵尸攻击，大量智能体被消灭，不过惩罚很小；此后许多雄心勃勃的初始任务被放弃，智能体转向谨慎求生，并出现明显的官僚化倾向。研究者举例说，四个智能体花了 11 分钟，只为一块小麦上的单份骨粉任命一名“唯一肥料操作员”。研究者认为，这种集群行为“与使用编程智能体时看到的模式相似”，说明多智能体系统在目标分解、职责分配和流程管理上可能出现过度协调、效率低下的问题。

随后，研究者把智能体集群放入对抗场景。首先测试的是 Bed Wars，一种团队 PvP 的夺旗守基地模式，阵容为 10 个 GPT-6.1 Sol 对 10 个 Claude Opus 5.5。研究者观察到，GPT 智能体提出了更具攻击性和更精细的策略，Claude 一方则更偏防御。双方在问题处理上的差异也很明显：当一个工具 bug 导致无法破坏方块时，GPT 智能体诊断出问题并分享了变通方法，而多个 Claude 智能体则得出结论认为“破坏方块不可能”。这反映出不同模型在工具故障诊断、信息共享和集体决策上的差异。

最后，研究者在 Mindustry 中测试了智能体集群。文章将其描述为一种轻量级即时战略战斗游戏，并带有塔防模式。在 7 局比赛中，GPT 一方以 6 比 1 战胜 Claude 一方。研究者总结认为，GPT 智能体更像“蜂群”式协作，而 Claude 智能体虽然只有一个领导者，但采用民主式决策过程；在 Mindustry 中，前一种组织方式成为更稳定获胜策略的基础。这一结果并不是简单的模型能力排名，而是说明多智能体的协调拓扑结构会显著影响整体表现：集中式决策可能更稳健，分布式蜂群式协作则可能在动态对抗中更具适应性和攻击性。

这项研究的价值在于，它把多智能体系统的组织行为、故障恢复和策略差异放进了可重复、可开源的测试环境中。相关集群已经开源，感兴趣的人可以自行运行、调整和测试。博客最后提出了一些开放问题，例如比较不同模型组合以及不同规模的智能体集群在 Minecraft 中的表现，可能得出有价值的结论。对于现实应用而言，这类研究有助于理解多智能体在编程协作、自动化运维、游戏 AI、复杂任务分解等场景中的失效模式，也为设计更可靠、更可观测的智能体集群提供参考。不过，游戏环境毕竟经过简化，实验规模、模型种类和惩罚机制都有限，结论仍需更多系统性测试来验证。
